items.name: turnstile
items.title: Turnstile
items.description: Cloudflare Turnstile, loaded when the visitor first touches a form, with a handle that resolves a token.

items.name: form-builder-form
items.title: Form builder form
items.description: Renders a Payload form-builder form with TanStack Form and shadcn fields, validates it in the browser, and submits it with a Turnstile token.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-form-builder at the version in this item's meta. The form calls submitForm from @/server/forms.functions, which you write and import once in the _frontend layout route. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/forms

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter sign-up
items.description: A one-line email sign-up that submits a form-builder form with a Turnstile token.
items.docs: Install @adirishi/offload-form-builder at the version in this item's meta. The sign-up calls submitForm from @/server/forms.functions, which you write and import once in the _frontend layout route. See https://adirishi.github.io/offload-cms/forms
